main_text.p: fcripto aduerfus Milleterium, cui Repli-catiomi[?] titulus eft, capite de æqualitate corruptionis hominum, & in Caluini defenfione, cap. 13.

In articulo fecundo Arminiani defendunt, Deum, poftquàm ex omni æternitate decreuit vnam candemque gratiam omnibus hominibus offerre, vt in ea vel recipienda, vel refpuenda vires liberi arbitrij explicarent, & poftquam præuidit quinam eam admiffuri effent, qui verò repudiaturi, ex ea præuisione elegiffe quos illa gratia bene[?] vsuros effe profpexit, reprobaffe alios. Adeò vt ex eorum opinione Electio fundata fit in Fidei præuisione.

Orthodoxi verò ftatuunt, tametsi Deus decreuerit omnes homines ad fidem indifferenter inuitare, fecreuisse tamen eum in æterno suo consilio certum quendam numerum hominum à reliquis, vt illis gratiam quandam singularem indulgeret, per quam inuitationi isti obsequerentur, & sic perducerentur ad salutem: Cæteros omnes ab eo in dispensatione illius gratiæ prætermissos esse tuentur. Addunt prætera cur Deus ita ageret adductum fuisse vno libertimo[?]

page.notes: The first line of the page continues a paragraph from the previous page. The last line is cut off at the bottom edge of the scan, so "libertimo" is uncertain. "Repli-catiomi" is hyphenated at the line end; the first letter of "catiomi" is unclear. "bene" has a mark over the final vowel that could be a printed abbreviation or damage. The printer uses "effe" and "effent" in the forms shown; these are left as printed.
